title: Turning tracking off on a part with nothing on hand still writes Tracking turned off
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) A tracked part with nothing on hand: if it does not exist, create "QAPL-Z0" at Staging Heavy Duty (New Inventory Part, tracking on, the default bin with quantity 0).
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory: click the QAPL-Z0 row; turn the "Track quantities and cost of goods" switch off and click Save.
  2. Open QAPL-Z0's Part History (row history icon).
  3. Back on Inventory, open QAPL-Z0, turn the switch on and click Save.
  4. Open QAPL-Z0's Part History again.
  5. Type "tracking turned" in the Part History search.
custom_expected:
1. Saved with no confirmation; Total Qty reads "Not Tracked"; the bin with quantity 0 stays.
  2. The newest entry reads "Tracking turned off" with Staff (your user), Date and Time, although nothing is on hand.
  3. Saved; QAPL-Z0 shows its count as it stands (nothing on hand) instead of "Not Tracked".
  4. A new, separate "Tracking turned on" entry with Staff, Date and Time; the "Tracking turned off" entry stays.
  5. Both entries are found.
